label: Page — The shop
description: The shop’s own page, with its sections kept as it was arranged.

settings.heading: Chairs, a lamp, and whoever is reading
settings.body:
The back room was a stockroom until 2006. It now holds twenty-five people, a piano nobody plays, and the monthly readings that have become the reason a lot of people come at all.

It is free to hire for reading groups and local writers. Ask at the counter.

settings.heading: How we work
settings.body:
We order what we would read and we say so when we have not read something. If a book is not right for you we would rather you put it back.

Buying

Tuesday mornings, a box at a time. We pay in cash or in credit, and credit is worth a third more.

Ordering

Almost anything in print arrives within three days. We hold it for a fortnight and we will text you when it lands.

settings.heading: Bring a box on a Tuesday
settings.text: We look at second-hand books from ten until one, and we will go through them with you.
